newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST BOURSE'S BUX SLIDES OVER FOUR PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST BOURSE'S BUX SLIDES OVER FOUR PERCENT.

text.p: The BUX index of the Budapest Stock Exchange slid in early trading on Monday, retreating below 8,000 points.
The BUX index opened at 8,039.51 points and at 0950 GMT traded at 7,955.60, down 391.92 points or 4.70 percent from Friday's close of 8,347.52.
"The correction was imminent," said one London-based analyst. "With a P/E ratio of around 16.6 the Budapest bourse is one of the most expensive bourses in the region".
The analyst added that over the last few months a massive inflow of foreign funds drove Hungarian share prices up but there are only a handful of sufficiently liquid papers to soak up that inflow.
"Prices rocketed and a correction was waiting to happen," he said.
